encodeBinary_array: encode a numpy array into binary format with metadata, shape, and float32 contents
decodeBinary_data: decode binary data back into a numpy array using stored metadata and shape
encodeReadable_array: encode a numpy array into a human-readable comma-separated string representation
decodeReadable_data: decode a human-readable numpy array string back into a numpy array
call_url_array: call a remote server at a given URL with a numpy array and return the response as a numpy array
